npc_intro.player_text: You look like a man who knows this place.

npc_identity.text: A navigator. I know the Baltic coasts and the old roads.

mock_outfit.text: You must have a lot of personality.

ask_if_comedian.text: Are you a comedian by any chance, Navigator?

leave.text: I will leave you to it.

npc_silent_stare.player_text: You must have a lot of personality.
npc_silent_stare.text: Who do you think you are?

leave.text: Then I shall leave you to your honor.

npc_final_insult.text: You insulted me for the last time.

npc_hendrik_identity.text: No, I am not. And the name is Hendrik.

leave.text: I will leave you to it.

npc_ask_name.text: Interesting that you ask. Before we discuss business, what is your name?

npc_ink_request.text: Good, Rebane. I have run out of ink, and without ink my maps are useless. Bring me some, and perhaps I will decide you are worth my time.

accept_ink_quest.text: I will find ink for you.

npc_after_identity.text: Back again? If you want a navigator's time, show me that you can notice what is needed.

npc_waiting_for_ink.text: Bring me ink for my maps, Rebane. Then we can discuss opportunities.

give_ink.text: Here is the ink you asked for.

npc_ink_thanks.player_text: About the ink for your charts...
npc_ink_thanks.text: Just what I needed. Thank you, Rebane.

old_sailor_look.text: An old sailor stands before me.

old_sailor_touch.text: I should keep my hands to myself.

walking_area_look.text: The road continues through the town square.

glowing_gem_look.text: A small gem pulses with an unnatural light.

glowing_gem_touch.text: The gem feels warm beneath my fingers.

clothes_trader_look.text: A clothes trader watches the square from behind an elaborate mask.

clothes_trader_touch.text: I should keep my hands off the trader's wares.

clothes_trader_talk.text: The clothes trader stares back at me without saying a word.

clothes_trader_walk.text: I can't walk through the clothes trader.

female_clothes_trader_look.text: A woman in traditional dress tends the clothes stall.

female_clothes_trader_touch.text: I should keep my hands off the trader's wares.

female_clothes_trader_talk.text: The clothes trader watches me quietly without saying a word.

female_clothes_trader_walk.text: I can't walk through the clothes trader.

generic_talk.text: There is no one to talk to.

ink_bottle_look.text: A bottle of dark ink. It might be useful for drawing charts.
